description: This file defines the 'PdfInteger' class, representing a 32-bit signed integer in the PDFsharp library, including conversions and serialization methods.

classes.name: PdfInteger
classes.description: Represents a direct 32-bit signed integer value in a PDF document, providing methods for type conversions and serialization.

methods.name: PdfInteger
